caption:
The AI built the edit profile form. Clear the phone field, save, refresh, and the old number is still there.

Look at the card. '' || undefined turns the empty field into undefined. JSON.stringify skips any property whose value is undefined, so the request body is {} and phone is never sent. A PATCH endpoint usually leaves fields it didn't receive alone, so the server keeps the old number.

Fix: send null when the user clears a field. null survives JSON.stringify, and the server can treat it as "remove".

Check the request payload in the Network tab, not just the form.

Source: MDN, JSON.stringify() (undefined values).
